parts.text: Remove the navy paisley bandana completely so his whole clay face shows, and give him a new face, all sculpted in the same matte clay: his eye on the LEFT side of the image is a big round brown eye with a darker brown ring around the iris, a black pupil and a white highlight; his eye on the RIGHT side of the image is replaced by a cracked rusty metal orb with a riveted rusty rim, a glowing purple cracked glass centre with tiny green sparks, and green slime dripping down from its bottom edge. Below them a huge wide grin stretching almost ear to ear, black inside, lined with chunky square white teeth on top and bottom, and pouring out of his open grin like he is throwing up: a cascade of shiny gold coins, sparkling diamonds and red rubies spilling down over his chin and chest. Keep everything else exactly the same: the black hoodie with hood up, the black cap, the gauged plugs, the bead necklace and cross, the tail, the paint roller in one hand, the spray can in the other, the pose, the art studio backdrop, the claymation style, lighting and framing. Plain cap front, no text or logos.
